notes: Sequential fresh four-worker relay on CPUs 0-3, frozen verified stress client on 4-7. Three alternating pairs per mode/payload, four seconds per case, 64 clients. Incoming rates disabled by the runner; other settings are in each command. CPU includes setup and teardown. Churn verifies normal Close; traffic intentionally drops 64 socket handles and accounts for every read/write departure. Finite loopback cost guard, no TLS/capacity guarantee.
